after_snippet:
from setuptools import Distribution
from setuptools.command.build import build

# In 83.0.0, dry_run has been removed
dist = Distribution({'name': 'test'})
cmd = build(dist)
# dry_run attribute no longer exists; attempting to set/read it raises AttributeError
try:
    cmd.dry_run = True
    raise AssertionError('Expected AttributeError')
except AttributeError:
    pass
before_snippet:
from setuptools import Distribution
from setuptools.command.build import build

# In 82.0.1, dry_run was supported on Distribution and commands
dist = Distribution({'name': 'test'})
cmd = build(dist)
cmd.dry_run = True
assert cmd.dry_run == True
title: Removal of dry_run support in Distribution and build commands
